# Codex rollout fixtures

Synthetic rollouts for `test/adapter-codex.test.mjs`. They are generated by
`make-fixtures.mjs` (the test suite regenerates them on every run, so edit the
generator, never the `.jsonl` files) and contain only deterministic lorem ipsum
text tagged with the word `LOREMSENTINEL`; nothing is copied from a real
transcript. Envelope and payload shapes follow `docs/format-codex.md`.

| File | Shape | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `plain-cli.jsonl` | `source: "cli"`, CLI 0.150.1, 2 turns, 6 requests | duplicate `session_meta` re-emit (no-op), `token_count` with `info: null`, developer parts (`skills_instructions`, `permissions instructions`, `collaboration_mode`, `apps_instructions`, `plugins_instructions`), user parts (`# AGENTS.md instructions for …`, `<environment_context>`, plain text, `<image …>` + `input_image`), `world_state.agents_md`, `exec` (JS `tools.exec_command`) classified as file / edit / shell, `function_call exec_command` classified as search, `web_search_call`, truncation markers (`Warning: truncated output (original token count: N)`, `…N tokens truncated…`, `Original token count: N`), a failed script (`Script failed`), an unknown top-level record type (`future_record`), a raw U+2028 handled by the U+2028 unit test, and a trailing partial JSON line (live file). |
| `compacted-desktop.jsonl` | `source: "vscode"`, CLI 0.147, `history_mode: legacy`, 1 real compaction, 10 requests | `turn_context.user_instructions` (old-style AGENTS chain) that changes between turns, `dynamic_tools` in the meta, 5 growing requests up to 225k, `compacted` → `world_state` → `turn_context` → all-zero `token_count` reset marker → `event_msg.context_compacted`, replacement history with an encrypted `compaction` item, then `spawn_agent` / `sub_agent_activity` / `wait_agent` (status-only output) and an `agent_message` from `/root/worker_a` to `/root` (the handoff). |
| `thread-spawn-child.jsonl` | `source.subagent.thread_spawn` (depth 1, nickname Darwin), 2 requests | child meta followed by the parent's meta copy, fork bootstrap `compacted` record (AGENTS.md user part, environment part, `You are an agent in a team…` role prompt, `<multi_agent_mode>`, encrypted compaction item) that must not become a Compaction, `inter_agent_communication_metadata{trigger_turn:true}` + incoming `agent_message` counted as the turn, `exec` with `tools.apply_patch` (two files), `send_message` in the collaboration namespace. |

Thread ids are fixed (`01a00000-0000-7000-8000-00000000000{1,2,3}`); the child's
`parent_thread_id` is the desktop thread so `siblingIndex` linkage can be tested.
`HOME` is `/home/synthetic` and `CWD` is `/home/synthetic/work/orchard`; the tests
assert neither string appears in the serialised Run.
